links.outcome: Standalone fracture detection accuracy of general-purpose LLM on distal radius radiographs
links.effect: Sensitivity 51.2% (43.7-58.6), specificity 70.5%; false negatives exceeded false positives (McNemar p=0.044); kappa 0.219; PPV 30.3% and NPV 85.2% at 20% prevalence.
links.quote: Under a minimal binary prompt and without task-specific fine-tuning, ChatGPT-5 missed approximately half of distal radius fractures and fell well below published performance for dedicated CNN-based fracture detectors.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the baseline diagnostic accuracy of a multimodal LLM (ChatGPT-5) on an existing radiograph dataset (Stanford MURA) using a standard binary prompt without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
